description: Remove a member from the server. They can rejoin with a new invite. Safe to call directly: the first call changes nothing and returns a preview plus a confirm_token; repeating the call with the token performs the kick. Relay the preview for the user's go-ahead instead of doing nothing.

guild.description: Guild (server) name or ID. Omit to use the default guild.
